messages:
Marta: Heads-up — Sandstone (trial) returned their vendor risk form. It's a combined SOC2 + DPA + custom section about embeddings retention. They flagged KMS and non-prod data access. Can someone help triage? Drive link they sent: https://drive.google.com/sandstone-form

Devon: I'll take KMS + infra questions. Do we have the standard BYOK language? :thinking_face:

Priya: Assign me for DPA scope clarifications and data residency. I can pull the last DPA template.

Marta: Thanks. Key asks from customer:
- Where keys are stored (BYOK options)
- Embeddings retention policy / deletion flow
- SOC2 evidence for access controls
- Endpoint encryption at rest

Nate: For BYOK we usually say: 'Customer-managed keys supported via AWS KMS or GCP KMS; HSM options via enterprise plan.' I can paste the standard snippet.

Priya: please paste

Nate: ```
Key management: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault. For on-prem/private deployments we support HSM integrations. Key rotation policies follow customer KMS settings; we never store plaintext keys in our control plane.
```

Devon: Regarding embeddings retention: default is 30 days ephemeral unless customer opts-in to longer retention for fine-tuning. Non-production data is segregated and flagged. For SOC2, we have control evidence in the 'access-control-evidence' folder — sending link.

Marta: Can someone draft short answers for the vendor form (they want bullet answers, max 3 lines each) by EOD? Customer renewal health looks healthy but they said this is required for procurement sign-off.

Priya: I'll handle DPA bullets. Devon — can you provide the infra bullets? Nate — legal review on BYOK phrasing?

Nate: I'll loop in @legal-ops — tagging Susie. @Susie can you do a quick review if the BYOK line is OK for procurement? :pray:

Susie: Susie: happy to review, give me 2 hours. Also confirm whether we can provide the KMS attestation doc. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.docs/sandstone/vendor-answer-draft (auto)

Marta: Great. Once we have bullets I'll upload to the vendor form and ping the customer. Thanks team. :rocket:
